e13pompd1cac1.speaker: narr
e13pompd1cac1.text: Autumn 1185. The valley of Iya blazed with red and gold autumn leaves.
e13pompd1cac1.heard: Autumn eleven eighty-five. The valley of Iya blazed with red and gold autumn leaves.
e13pompd1cac1.scene: おだやかな場面。落ち着いた声で

e1p8j98h15xda.speaker: narr
e1p8j98h15xda.text: High above the deep valley, men were quietly weaving shirakuchi-kazura (tough mountain vines).
e1p8j98h15xda.heard: High above the deep valley, men were quietly weaving shirakuchi-kazura, tough mountain vines.
e1p8j98h15xda.scene: おだやかな場面。落ち着いた声で

e8sdink1gtcw.speaker: noritsune
e8sdink1gtcw.scene: おだやかな場面。落ち着いた声で

e1kd0z1y3bcy9.speaker: noritsune
e1kd0z1y3bcy9.text: …You are not one of the men hunting us. Such strange clothes. Where do you come from?
e1kd0z1y3bcy9.heard: You are not one of the men hunting us. Such strange clothes. Where do you come from?
e1kd0z1y3bcy9.scene: おだやかな場面。落ち着いた声で

e1j8css01046x.speaker: nekmax
e1j8css01046x.text: W-we're just travelers! We're not suspicious, honest!
e1j8css01046x.scene: おだやかな場面。落ち着いた声で

e1at79jo85s4y.speaker: noritsune
e1at79jo85s4y.text: Suspicious people always say that. …Very well. I am Kunimori. I came into this valley to protect the Emperor.
e1at79jo85s4y.heard: suspicious people always say that Very well I am Kuni Mori I came into this valley to protect the Emperor
e1at79jo85s4y.scene: おだやかな場面。落ち着いた声で

e109ie2n1d2sc.speaker: nekmax
e109ie2n1d2sc.text: (whispering) This is Taira no Kunimori. Iya has an old legend: after losing the Battle of Yashima, Kunimori escaped here, protecting the Emperor — who was still a young boy.
e109ie2n1d2sc.heard: This is Taira no Kunimori. Iya has an old legend: after losing the Battle of Yashima, Kunimori escaped here, protecting the Emperor — who was still a young boy.
e109ie2n1d2sc.scene: おだやかな場面。落ち着いた声で

e1kr15g01av5e.speaker: nekmax
e1kr15g01av5e.text: (whispering) “Kunimori” was the earlier name of Taira no Noritsune, the fiercest warrior of the Heike (the Taira clan). That's why some people say, “Kunimori was Noritsune himself!”
e1kr15g01av5e.heard: "Kunimori" was the earlier name of Taira no Noritsune, the fiercest warrior of the Heike (the Taira clan). That's why some people say, "Kunimori was Noritsune himself!"
e1kr15g01av5e.scene: おだやかな場面。落ち着いた声で

elm2tsrt8r1a.speaker: noritsune
elm2tsrt8r1a.scene: おだやかな場面。落ち着いた声で

e5w69b9q4a9e.speaker: noritsune
e5w69b9q4a9e.text: The man before you now is only Kunimori, an ordinary man. Tell no one.
e5w69b9q4a9e.heard: The man before you now is only Kunimori, an ordinary man. Tell no one.
e5w69b9q4a9e.scene: おだやかな場面。落ち着いた声で

e13oomzv721y1.speaker: nekmax
e13oomzv721y1.text: (whispering) I knew it…! Just like the legend says — Noritsune, who vanished at Dan-no-ura, and Kunimori of Iya are the same person!
e13oomzv721y1.heard: I knew it…! Just like the legend says — Noritsune, who vanished at Dan-no-ura, and Kunimori of Iya are the same person!
e13oomzv721y1.scene: おだやかな場面。落ち着いた声で

ezeyxyfy8sh1.speaker: noritsune
ezeyxyfy8sh1.scene: おだやかな場面。落ち着いた声で

ed7fjc2tjldp.speaker: noritsune
ed7fjc2tjldp.text: Why do you look at me with such sad eyes? Do you know me?
ed7fjc2tjldp.scene: おだやかな場面。落ち着いた声で

e7dglbj1derz.speaker: nekmax
e7dglbj1derz.text: (whispering) For Kunimori, today is the first time he's ever met you. But you've already seen his “future,” haven't you?
e7dglbj1derz.heard: The Kunimori, today is the first time he's ever met you, but you've already seen his future, haven't you?
e7dglbj1derz.scene: おだやかな場面。落ち着いた声で

e325ihz1szpa.speaker: nekmax
e325ihz1szpa.text: (whispering) At Biwa Falls, Aya was mourning someone. “A man who vanished into the mountains last autumn”…
e325ihz1szpa.heard: At Biwa Falls, Aya was mourning someone. “A man who vanished into the mountains last autumn”
e325ihz1szpa.scene: おだやかな場面。落ち着いた声で

emsb6xafv9g1.speaker: noritsune
emsb6xafv9g1.scene: おだやかな場面。落ち着いた声で

e1inz2vg1elki.speaker: noritsune
e1inz2vg1elki.text: Look. We weave this bridge from kazura vines.
e1inz2vg1elki.heard: Look. We weave this bridge from kazura vines.
e1inz2vg1elki.scene: おだやかな場面。落ち着いた声で

e1he3x8q2vp41.speaker: noritsune
e1he3x8q2vp41.text: That way, a single axe can cut it down in a moment.
e1he3x8q2vp41.heard: that way, a single axe can cut it down in a moment.
e1he3x8q2vp41.scene: おだやかな場面。落ち着いた声で

e14s38hv18u4z.speaker: noritsune
e14s38hv18u4z.text: It is for the day our enemies, the Genji (the Minamoto clan), chase us into this valley.
e14s38hv18u4z.heard: It is for the day our enemies, the Genji (the Minamoto clan), chase us into this valley.
e14s38hv18u4z.scene: おだやかな場面。落ち着いた声で

e1dq2kso1bhbi.speaker: noritsune
e1dq2kso1bhbi.text: Drop the bridge, and no one can cross from the other side. Then we can keep the Emperor safe.
e1dq2kso1bhbi.heard: Drop the bridge, and no one can cross from the other side. Then we can keep the Emperor safe.
e1dq2kso1bhbi.scene: おだやかな場面。落ち着いた声で

e46smdlqv26b.speaker: noritsune
e46smdlqv26b.text: Yes. A bridge for crossing — and we weave it so it can be cut.
e46smdlqv26b.heard: Yes, a bridge for crossing, and we weave it so it can be cut.
e46smdlqv26b.scene: おだやかな場面。落ち着いた声で

eu46cp4k0m4x.speaker: noritsune
eu46cp4k0m4x.text: …A strange thing, is it not? But it is all we have left.
eu46cp4k0m4x.heard: A strange thing, is it not? But it is all we have left.
eu46cp4k0m4x.scene: おだやかな場面。落ち着いた声で

e185ojsxrnume.speaker: nekmax
e185ojsxrnume.text: There's another story about how the vine bridge (Kazurabashi) began. They say Kobo Daishi, a famous Buddhist monk, built it for villagers who had no way to cross the valley.
e185ojsxrnume.heard: There's another story about how the vine bridge, Kazurabashi, began. They say Kobo Daishi, a famous Buddhist monk, built it for villagers who had no way
e185ojsxrnume.scene: おだやかな場面。落ち着いた声で

eg5levt1eqqs.speaker: noritsune
eg5levt1eqqs.text: A monk's tale, is it? …That story is far better. A bridge made to help people across.
eg5levt1eqqs.heard: A monk's tale, is it? …That story is far better. A bridge made to help people
eg5levt1eqqs.scene: おだやかな場面。落ち着いた声で
